title: Nicely Nicotine-Noked Andalusian Lamb Kidney Patatas-Bravas Style Cooked Potatoes
description: A flavorful Spanish-inspired one-pot dish featuring lamb kidney, served with smoky potatoes.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large, heavy Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb kidneys, browning them on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the onion, cooking until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the potatoes, red pepper flakes, and browned lamb kidneys. Stir to combine.
Cover and transfer the pot to the preheated oven (400°F / 200°C). Roast for 45 minutes or until the potatoes are tender and the potatoes are nicely browned.
Remove from the oven and garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and a side of warm crusty bread, if desired.
